text: {"assertions":["A duplicate charge bug was discovered in billing/webhooks/stripe.py that only affected accounts in a 5% rollout bucket.","The root cause of the duplicate charge was a naive datetime being compared against an aware datetime.","The duplicate charge manifested as two ledger rows sharing the same event id.","The fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge, implemented in PR #1384 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1.","The duplicate charge bug could be reproduced by redelivering the same webhook id twice.","Tests for Stripe webhook functionality are located in tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py.","After the fix was deployed, the billing alert remained quiet for 33 consecutive days."]}
